title: SaaS Plan Limits + Billing Page + Size Enforcement
description: Implement plan system with soft creation limits, database size enforcement before pg_dump, and billing page. Free plan: 1 DB, 1 job, 1 storage, 0.5GB size limit, 7-day retention, no S3/notifications. Enterprise plan derived from enterprise_quotes. Admins bypass all limits. Billing page shows usage + upgrade CTA.
close_reason: Implemented: migration, User plan methods, PlanEnforcement concern, controller enforcement on 4 controllers, pre-dump size check in BackupExecutionJob, retention validation, billing page with free/enterprise views, sidebar link, quote slot dropdown in DB form.

title: CRITICAL: Add VPN binaries to production Dockerfile
description: Production Dockerfile is missing openvpn, strongswan, wireguard-tools, openssh-client, and proxychains-ng. All VPN connections fail with 'command not found'. Must mirror Dockerfile.dev lines 51-58.

title: MAJOR: Fix IPSec config path - writes to /etc/swanctl requiring root
description: IpsecConnection and IpsecSimpleConnection write to /etc/swanctl/conf.d which requires root. Container runs as uid 1000. Must move to Rails.root.join('tmp', 'vpn') with --conf flag.

title: MAJOR: Fix WireGuard config writes to /etc/wireguard with wrong permissions
description: WireGuard config containing private keys written to /etc/wireguard/ system path without enforced permissions. Should write to tmp dir with 0600 perms, use wg-quick with explicit path.

title: MAJOR: Verify SyncExecutionJob VPN integration
description: SyncExecutionJob does not include VpnConnectable mixin unlike Backup/Restore/HealthCheck jobs. Sync to VPN-protected databases will fail. Need to verify if SyncService handles VPN internally or add the mixin.
close_reason: SyncService already handles VPN internally via Vpn::ConnectionFactory.with_connection_for() on lines 35 and 41. Not a bug.

title: MODERATE: Improve OpenVPN connection detection - replace log file polling
description: OpenVPN connected? check relies on parsing log file for 'Initialization Sequence Completed' string. Race condition: interface may exist before log written. Different OpenVPN versions may log differently. Replace with interface + ip link check.

title: MODERATE: Add retry logic for SSH tunnel port binding collisions
description: SSH tunnel uses deterministic port from Zlib.crc32(tunnel_name). Two concurrent jobs for same DB could collide if advisory lock times out. Add retry with backoff for 'Address already in use' errors.

title: MINOR: Fix ConnectionMonitor thread leak on timeout
description: ConnectionMonitor.stop uses join(5) which silently loses thread reference if timeout occurs. Thread continues running. Over time, threads accumulate. Should use Thread.kill or better sync.
